title: Austin Takes Action: Tax Relief, Development
summary:
*   **City Tax Reduction & Budget:** The city council approved a 10% reduction in 1932 property taxes for residents and businesses, while also adopting the comprehensive 1933 municipal budget.
*   **New Infrastructure:** Plans moved forward to extend sanitary sewers to Bouldin Street and permits were issued for a new gasoline filling station (with strict waste disposal and construction requirements) and for new telephone pole lines.
*   **Urban Planning:** A significant project was approved to revise house numbering in a large northern area (Area No. V) to improve city organization.
*   **Park and Road Development:** Two land parcels were acquired for future public use, expanding city parks and road networks near Shoal Creek and 16th Street.
